name: ELIX Files
description: Modern high-performance file manager and storage navigator with quick preview, archive utilities, and AI tool bindings for ELIX OS

list_directory.name: list_directory
list_directory.description: List files and subdirectories with sorting, hidden file toggles, and metadata summaries.

showHidden.description: Whether to include hidden files (starting with dot)

search_files.name: search_files
search_files.description: Perform fuzzy and recursive file search across directory trees with extension filters.

rootDirectory.description: Root directory path to start searching from

recursive.description: Whether to traverse child directories recursively

inspect_file_metadata.name: inspect_file_metadata
inspect_file_metadata.description: Inspect detailed file system metadata (size, MIME type, POSIX permissions, birth/mod times).

targetPath.description: Absolute or relative file path to inspect

manage_archive.name: manage_archive
manage_archive.description: Compress files/folders into a ZIP archive or extract archives with directory traversal protection.

sourcePaths.description: List of source file or directory paths

destinationPath.description: Destination archive or extraction folder path

get_storage_breakdown.name: get_storage_breakdown
get_storage_breakdown.description: Query storage utilization breakdown across drives, document caches, and partitions.

drivePath.description: Optional target mount point or drive letter
